sources.title: Indiana Election Division, certified 2024 General Election results archive (ENR), office category 1006 JSON with county breakdown (settings: Certified=T)
Indiana Election Division, 2024 General Election results archive

method: pipeline/patches/2024_IN_SEN_monroe.py (via _in_enr.py) takes the Monroe County entry from the certified JSON. Party D is dem, R is rep, and Libertarian, independent and write-in candidates are oth.
validation: Monroe 18105 = official county totals dem 35,960 / rep 21,187 / oth 1,521 (MIT had only dem 9,991 / rep 4,915). Certified statewide: dem 1,097,061 / rep 1,659,416. With this fill, the MIT-based state total is dem 1,178,828 (+7.5%) / rep 1,762,753 (+6.2%). The excess is outside Monroe: MIT counts Hendricks (18063) and St. Joseph (18141) twice, and Marshall (18099) and Warrick (18173) are slightly short.
